title: My SW SB Jabba's Skiff box  (December 28 ) was Late But I love the Funko Pops!!
text: The Funko Pops came in perfect condition.  So for a Star Wars collector like My I was super excited with the Lando Kalrissian Pop! The detail on the helmet and mouth piece was amazing.  I actually like the Klaatu skiff gaurd pop as well surprisingly.  The mini pop was cool.  For this Theme I thought the shot glasses (let's call it for with they are) were a nice touch.  I gave them to my mother to add to her shot class collection from places she's traveled to. Overall I think this Bounty Box was the best one so far.  Looking fWD to the Dagobah smuggler's bounty box!
label: positive
